annotations.title: Confirm my side of a Handshake

description: Use this to confirm the user's side of a Handshake when get_handshake reports payment.state = 'covered', meaning nothing is owed. No money moves. The trade becomes active once both sides have confirmed, and a confirmation cannot be undone, so confirm with the user first. If a fee is owed instead, this returns an error and changes nothing.
name: confirm_handshake
title: Confirm my side of a Handshake
